requirement.statement: MessageHistoryGraph SHALL project its append-only semantic input through the unified DataGraph stream-driven state-signal contract, without retaining removed ReducerProjection APIs, while preserving transcript, committed-message, anomaly, completion, and disposal behavior.

case.given: MessageHistoryGraph receives semantic events through its ordered input log
case.when: it reduces a transcript state and exposes listener notifications
case.then: it SHALL register the log stream as a DataGraph source and read a stream-driven state-signal handle output
it SHALL NOT import or reference ReducerProjection or createReducerProjection

case.given: existing history transcript fixtures and listener lifecycle tests
case.when: the unified projection receives semantic events, completion, or disposal
case.then: they SHALL preserve current emitted records and committed messages, stop after completion, and dispose graph subscriptions without disposing the independently owned input log twice
